description: Land Acquisition. - Nagaha Koratuwa, Karangoda Village D/S Division, Ratnapura District (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of a particular land parcel (0.0179 Hectare in Nagahakoratuwa) for government purposes, including detailed land description, boundaries, and compensation procedures. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
